items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 61:1
items.html: For there are four discernments of coarseness in every Melech [king], called paths, meaning that upon them the coupling is made with the upper light, each producing a stature of ten Sefirot according to the measure of its coarseness. And eight times four is thirty-two. And the illumination of Aba in them is called the thirty-two paths of Chochma, since it illuminates in each and every one of these thirty-two paths. (870, item 14).
